differences: Native factory asChild/Slot replaces React element cloning, not an element-introspection compatibility shim.
Deprecated children-only Dialog.WarningProvider is deliberately removed.
Themes getSubtree/requireReactElement are React-introspection helpers and deliberately removed.
Owned native effects/settlement, refs, size observers and layer callbacks replace React hooks; no hook-name compatibility aliases.

Slider names target thumbs; ScrollArea defaults to keyboard-focusable; readable Select placeholders, forced-color boundaries and system-foreground loading spinners with transparent named labels are deliberate accessibility corrections.
manualGates: Package namespace/domain/account ownership and explicit release authorization remain required before any npm publication.
Solid stable-version decision plus rerunning the same gate before a stable release.
